entries.description: a bold bronze round emblem showing a roaring lion face and a short ruby flame crest
a refined bronze laurel medallion with a curved bow and turquoise arrow
a heavy bronze medallion with a strong classical shield and ivory central boss
a bronze ring embracing three clearly separated orange flame, blue ice shard and cyan lightning symbols
a bronze ring embracing two clasped armored hands above a small jade oath gem
an ancient Greek heroic profile helmet medallion in warm bronze with an ivory crest

payload.prompt: Match the reference image painting and material finish: premium hand-painted fantasy RPG art, generous sculpted forms, warm aged bronze, dark petrol stone, restrained turquoise, amber highlights from upper left, soft colored outlines and graduated shadows. Greek mythic underworld Catabase. Strong readable silhouettes and calm broad forms. No modern objects, no text, no lettering, no digits, no labels, no watermark. Create one production atlas of EXACTLY 6 separate icons in a regular 3 columns by 2 rows grid. Read order is left to right, then top to bottom. Each object fills about 68 percent of its cell, centered, equally scaled, generous empty margins, no overlap between cells. Three-quarter object view, front-readable glyphs where appropriate. Every pixel of the empty background must be uniform midnight blue #141D2E. No paper, no scene, no background texture or cast shadows beyond each object. No visible grid lines or frames around atlas cells. DO NOT repeat the reference objects; paint the requested new subjects. Exact contents: cell 1: a bold bronze round emblem showing a roaring lion face and a short ruby flame crest; cell 2: a refined bronze laurel medallion with a curved bow and turquoise arrow; cell 3: a heavy bronze medallion with a strong classical shield and ivory central boss; cell 4: a bronze ring embracing three clearly separated orange flame, blue ice shard and cyan lightning symbols; cell 5: a bronze ring embracing two clasped armored hands above a small jade oath gem; cell 6: an ancient Greek heroic profile helmet medallion in warm bronze with an ivory crest.
